name: RPG Maker MV / MZ

decoders.tileset_a1: RPGTilesheetVX: animated water (floor layout, frames 0,1,2,1) and waterfalls (frames 0,1,2)
decoders.tileset_a4: RPGTilesheetVX: 48 wall-top (floor layout) and wall-side (wall layout) autotiles
decoders.tileset_b: RPGTilesheetVX: B-E, 256 plain upper tiles each; B 0 is the eraser
decoders.charset: RPGCharset: 4x2 characters per sheet; a $ prefix (also after !) means one character

limitations: A2 table tiles are drawn without legs
A1 deep sea and decorations and the transparent A2 kinds get a hidden base (sea / the ground) only when painted on Layer 1; on other layers they are drawn as they are
A2 overlays are found from transparent pixels, not from the tileset mode (world / area)
roof and wall connections across different kinds
passability stored in the original database files is not read
a full A1-A4 set builds a large 48 px autotile atlas (about 80 MB RGBA)
